name: Cyber Safety Review Board (CSRB)
description: Independent review body modeled on the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) that conducts post-incident reviews of significant cybersecurity incidents.

peerReview.processDescription: Independent body modeled on NTSB. Post-incident reviews by government and industry leaders. Public reporting of findings. Multi-stakeholder input. Recommendations drive national cybersecurity policy improvements.

attribution.attributionNotes: Board membership by appointment from top government/industry leaders. Recommendations influence national policy.

povsAlignment.description: Internal audit success through independent post-incident review and policy recommendations.
